{{Top|leg}}
The '''Life To Come''' was the afterlife of the [[Cosmic Balance|Followers of the Cosmic Balance]]. As part of their creed, [[ascetic]] Followers who had been given the [[Bowl]] expected to be raised up in the afterlife over their siblings who had been given the [[Feather]].
